timing_statement: Revision-stage exploratory protocol after original and prior adjusted results were known; locked before any new M0/M1 bridge effects or adjusted CAMERA computations.
purpose: Bridge sample-set versus covariate-specification changes on the exact existing clinical43 set, without causal decomposition or new feature selection.

participants.inclusion: exact previously saved clinical43 membership, not regenerated according to outcomes
participants.unknown_categories: retain source-coded Unknown in TBI and prior_CNS

expression.scale: original supplied ComBat-normalized log expression scale; no further log transform, normalization or ComBat
expression.gene_order: exact GO_tested_gene_universe row order, verified identical to original SCI_vs_TC_processed_limma gene order
expression.duplicate_symbols: first source-matrix row retained, as prior analysis

coding.contrasts: contr.treatment with first level as reference
coding.age_c: age minus mean(age) in exact clinical43
coding.iss_c: iss minus mean(iss) in exact clinical43
coding.centering_note: Uses same-43 centers as old whole-gene clinical model and latest BTM set. Earlier original-score fixed-sample protocol used full48 centers; constant centering with intercept and no interactions leaves group coefficient and fitted values unchanged. Do not alter historical files or frozen scores.

models.name: clinical_same43
models.formula: ~ group + age_c + sex + iss_c + tbi + prior_cns

gene_test.BH: p.adjust(P.Value, method='BH', n=17498) separately for each of M0/M1/M2
gene_test.sort: preserve locked gene order, not significance
gene_test.not_HC3: limma moderated inference for genes; existing score regressions use OLS/HC3 and are separate analyses

pathway_test.input: same 17498-by-43 expression and respective locked design
pathway_test.BH: all 4032 GO sets separately within M0/M1/M2; keep original IDs and names
pathway_test.display_panel: reuse existing eight GO_camera_figure_panel IDs regardless of significance, no extra favorable terms
pathway_test.report: complete NGenes, Direction, PValue, FDR, GO ID and term for every model; no pathway effect CI invented

multiplicity.family_failure_rule: Keep NA failures and planned family n; do not silently reduce BH denominator or change method.
multiplicity.historical_families: 16/18/88/240 and within-spec families remain unchanged. Bridge families do not replace them or claim study-wide/post-selection error control.
multiplicity.cross_model_rule: All 3 models and all tests are exploratory. Do not select a preferred model/term/gene by smallest q. FDR<0.05 for any of 3 models is not a jointly controlled study-wide claim.
multiplicity.CI_note: 95% pointwise intervals, not simultaneous or multiplicity-adjusted intervals

reuse.status: candidate identified; provenance/design/universe checked in preflight; numerical equivalence deferred to execution
requirements: exact participant IDs and all covariates
same original matrix and gene order
same factor coding and model column space
reuse.execution_check: Validate new M2 fit against candidate by gene for logFC, CI.L, CI.R, t, P.Value and adj.P.Val, with absolute tolerance 1e-8 and relative tolerance 1e-8. A single reproduction for QA is not a new independent model. If not reproduced, investigate and retain discrepancy before any promotion.
reuse.camera_note: old 48-person unadjusted CAMERA is only an anchor; 43-person CAMERA under all three models is new and cannot be relabeled as already done

diagnostics: model rank, residual df and group coefficient estimability
design-only leverage/condition and existing clinical overlap audit; no significance-driven exclusions
record numerical or variance/test warnings without changing gene universe

reporting.primary_interpretation: estimated association and uncertainty, along with dependence on clinical adjustment and limited common support
reporting.DEG_counts: descriptive FDR<0.05 counts, with historical abs(logFC)>1 counts if shown; no new fold-change threshold
reporting.model_change: coefficient/CI changes are descriptive and path-dependent; no percentage explained or significance-of-difference claim
reporting.negative_results: retain full null/non-significant results; no result-directed method/subset changes
reporting.independence: no new cohort, no SCI specificity proven, no cell-intrinsic/functional inference

out_of_scope: new feature selection, LASSO or prediction
new signature, weighting or threshold tuning
new label permutation, ML or targeted subgroup selection
stop_rules: 43/36/7 membership, gene universe or GO membership mismatch
new M2 does not reproduce historical output within tolerance
amendment_rule: Do not edit a sealed protocol in place. Append a dated amendment, reason and before/after hashes, disclose whether new effects were already seen. Never backdate or silently widen scope.

packaging_amendment.purpose: Paths and data-sharing classification only; results were already known. No analysis method, participant set, gene universe or model changed.
